title: Han Cong's final speed
description: Essential: The answer must state Han Cong's speed after the push as 1 m/s (or -1 m/s indicating direction).

title: Conservation of momentum application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply momentum conservation to the two-skater system, setting initial total momentum equal to final total momentum.

title: Direction of Han Cong's velocity
description: Important: The answer must indicate that Han Cong's velocity after the push is opposite to the original direction of motion.

title: Force magnitude from impulse
description: Essential: The answer must state the magnitude of the average force as 60 N.

title: Impulse-momentum theorem for Han Cong
description: Important: The solution must apply the impulse-momentum theorem correctly to Han Cong to relate the average force, time, and his change in momentum.

title: Sign error in force direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force's sign is misinterpreted, failing to recognize it as an interaction pair or misstating its direction relative to the motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m/s, s, N) throughout the calculation.

title: Correct mass assignment
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the masses of Sui Wenjing (40 kg) and Han Cong (60 kg) are swapped in the equations.
